details.description: Modified root __init__.py to use lazy imports with try/except blocks to prevent circular import issues and timeouts. All component imports now gracefully degrade to None if dependencies are missing.
Added missing exports: get_metrics, get_cache_stats, MetricsCollector. Previously only exported get_logger, setup_logging, EmbeddingCache, FeatureCache.

Added fallback implementations for all dependencies. Module can now function even if core.types, core.errors, or utils modules are not available. Uses local stub classes for SubProblem, ComplexityScore, ClassificationError, EmbeddingCache, FeatureCache.
Added YAML/JSON fallback for config serialization. Module can now function without PyYAML installed (falls back to JSON).
Added graceful handling for missing psutil dependency. All system checks (memory, CPU, disk) return UNKNOWN status with appropriate message when psutil is not available.
Added fallback for missing metrics dependency. Dashboard methods return appropriate error messages when metrics collector is not available.
Added fallback logger for when utils.logger is not available. Alerting engine functions independently of other modules.

root_cause_analysis.issue: The import errors were not due to missing module files, but rather due to:
causes: Circular import dependencies between adaptive_mdap modules
Root __init__.py attempting to import all submodules simultaneously, causing timeouts
Some modules importing from utils before utils was fully initialized
Missing optional dependency handling (psutil, yaml, numpy, scipy)
utils/__init__.py not exporting get_metrics function that other modules expected

solution_applied.strategy: Made all imports in root __init__.py lazy with try/except blocks
benefits: Modules that fail to import gracefully return None instead of crashing
No circular import issues since each import is isolated
Package can be imported even if some dependencies are missing
Individual modules can be imported independently

recommendations: To use adaptive_mdap, add 'core-projects' to your PYTHONPATH
Import individual submodules rather than the entire package for faster loading
Install optional dependencies (psutil, pyyaml) for full functionality
Check for None values when accessing imports from adaptive_mdap (e.g., if adaptive_mdap.TaskComplexityClassifier is not None:)
usage_example: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'core-projects'); from adaptive_mdap import TaskComplexityClassifier, get_logger; classifier = TaskComplexityClassifier()
